current_difficulty_reason: Kolmogorov extension does not itself supply transition kernels that are simultaneously Markov-consistent and minimal among increasing-kernel couplings. The authors construct the monotone supremum on quantile levels and prove convergence and compatibility using a contraction metric on fixed-marginal couplings. The separate product-coupling induction establishes minimality and uniqueness without introducing temporal regularity assumptions.
